description: This file defines an interface `SnapshotConfig` that provides configuration settings related to entity snapshots, including interval and threshold parameters. It also contains an enumeration `SnapshotConfigValue` implementing `KnownConfigValue`, which specifies default configuration values and their paths for snapshot settings.

classes.name: SnapshotConfig
classes.description: Immutable interface providing snapshot configuration settings such as interval and threshold.

classes.name: SnapshotConfig.SnapshotConfigValue
classes.description: Enum defining known configuration path expressions and their default values for SnapshotConfig, including interval and threshold.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for doing snapshots on changed entities.

methods.name: getThreshold
methods.description: Returns the change threshold count to trigger a snapshot.

methods.name: getDefaultValue
methods.description: Provides the default value for the configuration setting.

methods.name: getConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the configuration path string for this setting.
